title: Folio AI icon studio and shared account settings

sourceBaseline.description: Clean GitHub main ca95e01; existing owner-private Site version11 source 1e84baac. Three independent current source/package/auth assessments. New scope only; previous completed release preserved.

in: S1–S3 existing accepted app; S4 shared AI companion/package integration, same-page SVG review, original Images to SVG entry, curated device-local icon library and recolor/export, compact shared settings/profile with existing Site authentication, tests and frequent commits/pushes/private publication.

[https://github.com/aipieksel/zipped-media-to-library-app](https://github.com/aipieksel/zipped-media-to-library-app) [$ai-development-workflow](app://plugins_6ac8be18596c8191a207070d92097236) [https://folio-html-workspace.byronjacobs.chatgpt.site/](https://folio-html-workspace.byronjacobs.chatgpt.site/) "**Build a standalone, local PNG-to-SVG icon converter.** Prioritize an exact visual match at the PNG’s original dimensions.

**Default mode — pixel vectors:** Decode each PNG to RGBA pixels and generate real SVG geometry for the visible pixels. Merge adjacent pixels of identical color and opacity to reduce file size. Preserve dimensions, transparency, and antialiased edge pixels. This mode should produce editable SVG fills, while keeping the original pixel-grid appearance.

**Second mode — embedded PNG:** Place the original PNG bytes inside an SVG for cases where pixel vectors become impractically large. Label this clearly as a bitmap inside an SVG, not editable vector artwork.

**Interface:** Make it a standalone local tool with drag-and-drop batch import, original and SVG previews, individual downloads, and a ZIP download. Preserve source filenames where possible and resolve collisions safely. Files must never leave the device.

**Fidelity check:** Render each generated SVG at its native dimensions and compare its RGBA pixels with the decoded source PNG. Show “pixel match verified” only when there are zero visible differences; otherwise show the differing-pixel count. Test opaque, transparent, partially transparent, antialiased, palette-based, and multicolor PNGs.

**Be honest about the limit:** Pixel-exact SVG geometry will still look pixelated when enlarged. Smooth, editable curves cannot generally be recovered exactly from arbitrary PNGs. Do not claim universal pixel accuracy across browsers or color profiles without testing it."

Okay, so you'll see that I've added a repository, one ChatGPT site, a brief, and the AI development workflow. Now, I want you to modify our app on our repository that we have and add what the brief says to our existing repository application that we already have, right? So instead of making it a standalone where it's just that, build it into our current one that we have. Obviously you will need to be sure that there is proper navigation and that the UI makes sense. The UI already works great. So it's the perfect UI. But obviously now because we're adding a new feature, we need to extend it a bit to make it a bit more improved, right? So please do that. And then what I want you to do is choose the best— sorry, choose from the AI development workflow the relative phases and agents and tools that you need and plan it accordingly in order to do this as accurately and as good and as successfully as you can, please. And then do it from start to finish, all in one go. But it's very important that after each step or each phase or each milestone or each big piece of code, that you commit to the repository constantly, so that when something does crash on ChatGPT and it does stop working or you time out, that work is not lost, please.
Independent assessment C1–C13: React/TS/Vite; preserve ItemKind/database/collection state, local converter isolation, reusable compact design, Worker deployment and source privacy.

requirements.text: Use the exact existing Library sidebar, search and tree for Icons, preserving familiar controls.

Retain clearly labeled original-byte embedded PNG mode.
Support batch import, responsive interactions, bounded conversion and useful failure recovery.
Show aligned original and actual SVG previews at native size and enlarged sizes.
Provide individual and ZIP downloads with safe unique source-based filenames.
Keep ordinary conversion and stored media device-local; send only explicitly selected AI inputs through the paired CLI to the selected provider; keep private media and credentials out of GitHub.
Independently render each downloaded SVG at native dimensions; verify only zero visible RGBA differences and otherwise show the count.
Test opaque, transparent, partial-alpha, antialiased, palette and multicolor PNGs, including new tracing regressions.
State scaling, approximation, color-reference and tested-browser limits honestly.
Use the selected workflow phases and real independent review, then complete verified implementation.
Commit and push each meaningful milestone frequently.
Publish the verified revision to the existing owner-private Site.
Move HTML and Images to top navigation and add Icons alongside them.
Place conversion mode and preview controls in the canvas toolbar; remove the separate converter sidebar/drop-zone.
Accept file and directory drops on sidebar or canvas and preserve nested folder structure.
Place loose PNGs into a persistent default Uncategorized folder.
Persist original icons, folders and completed results locally across navigation and reload.
Automatically convert newly imported PNGs after durable import and recover interrupted queued work.
Research current image-to-SVG repositories and methods deeply using primary sources and select an implementable local approach.
Implement a researched smooth-curve option for scalable artwork and measure its actual native error without weakening exact mode.

Recreate or clean up the selected icon as an editable SVG with AI on the existing conversion page; review and save the result without replacing the source conversion.
Use a source-aware SVG reconstruction prompt that preserves the design, proportions, dimensions, transparency and colors; report actual fidelity without promising universal perfection.

Test a real image-to-SVG request using the user’s own OpenAI account; distinguish it from mocks, catalog discovery and app sign-in.

Add a compact global menu and Settings with AI and Profile tabs using the established components and shared sidebar.
Expose real account sign-in/sign-out through the existing Site authentication boundary.
Show the authenticated profile and profile preferences, with accurate password/security management through the account provider.
